Q5028.reason: A proposed school-site label in a sales brochure and on a recorded plat is only a proposal, so it is an unenforceable restriction.

Q5787.reason: Intent limited to a slight wound is battery-level mens rea, and an unintended killing during that unlawful act is involuntary manslaughter.

Q5115.reason: At exercise onset glycolysis speeds up and forms pyruvate faster than mitochondria can oxidize it, so muscle lactate production rises.
